subtitle: A dependency written against an alias

Read the dependsOn below: `iron_lesson` is not the id of anything.
It is the alias declared one file up, and it resolves because an
alias is a first-class name everywhere an id is -- in dependsOn, in
commands, and in the editor's picker.
